name: Zerin
summary: Zerin presents an Italian white ceramic top with a smooth, contemporary clarity that gives the piece a bright, refined presence. The body is finished in a rich brass metallic tone, adding a warm, luminous character that contrasts beautifully with the cool ceramic. Inside, melamine panels keep the interior crisp and orderly, rounding out a design that feels composed and distinctly upscale without echoing anything else Top with 5mm Italy white ceramic, the body paint in brass metallic, inner panels with melamine. 110x42x75
